command: Compose one deterministic hidden256 BF16 block from the proven global RMSNorm256, 256x256 tiled GEMV, RoPE, online-softmax, OProj, residual, second RMSNorm, gate/up, SiLU, gate-times-up, down and final residual paths. Reuse the unchanged logical 16x32 BF16 array and existing heterogeneous FP32 SFUs. Freeze a compact hidden256 test shape that exercises every node without materializing a score matrix; generate operation-order node goldens and compare every saved Q/K/V, RoPE, M/L/O, OProj, MLP and residual node. Record Matrix/SFU/total cycles separately. Do not claim target-shape or q128 closure from this hidden256 gate.
success_condition: All frozen hidden256 intermediate nodes and final output are bit-exact against the operation-order model; no complete attention score matrix is stored; RTL counters distinguish Matrix, SFU and total cycles; strict Verilator lint passes; all build/test commands remain CPU 8-25, max j4 and under the 10 GiB cap.
failure_policy: Stop at the first mismatching node and preserve its exact input/output slice. Do not relax thresholds, replace global RMSNorm with per-chunk normalization, bypass the physical 16x32 array with a software result, materialize the complete score matrix, or label hidden256 evidence as target-shape/q128/q384/decode closure.
